name: envelope
comment: Sig: [yupper, ylower] = envelope(x). NUMERICAL VALUES DELIBERATELY NOT FINGERPRINTED — numkit uses FFT analytic-signal envelope (lower=-upper, symmetric); MATLAB's default uses SPLINE-PEAK interpolation (asymmetric). Closes the 2-output API gap (was returning empty for 2nd out); numerical match deferred (would require porting spline interpolation over local maxima/minima). 'analytic' / 'rms' / 'peak' mode arguments + filter-length form throw clear 'not yet implemented' errors.
